== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Subspace is an extra-dimensional realm that serves as the primary method for long-distance travel, as moving through real space is considered impossible for such distances without it. It can manifest in reality as colorful, swirling wormholes or distortions that range from small openings to massive holes capable of swallowing planets. Visually, the dimension is described as a kaleidoscopic or rainbow-colored environment, though its surface layer can appear as pure darkness. As travelers move deeper into the realm, the environment becomes increasingly strange and potentially sanity-shattering for the human mind. This phenomenon, often called [[Subspace madness]], involves individuals becoming obsessed with the visible patterns and traveling elsewhere. Navigation through Subspace requires a specialized [[Subspace Drive]]. The process of diving into this dimension involves significant physical strain; pulling matter like atmosphere into the realm creates violent storms that can damage or destroy vessels. While small ships can perform short hops or micro-dives, larger ships face greater risks and cannot safely dive while within a planet's atmosphere. [[Traveling]] through Subspace also impacts communication, making long-range signals unreliable or garbled. The dimension is inhabited by creatures that follow alien biological laws and can sense a ship's drive, particularly if the hull is compromised, as they seek it for nourishment. Additionally, unprotected mortals entering Subspace face physical danger, such as their bodies warping or being buffeted by currents that attempt to push them back into reality. While most incursions are safe if protected by shields and weaponry, the realm remains a place of significant danger due to its unpredictable nature and inhabitants.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Subspace is an isolated pocket dimension and a multicolored twist of reality where targets of the [[Absolute Burial]] spell are sent. While it serves as a medium for long-distance transportation and a place where ships can dive to evade enemies or avoid annihilation, it is also a region where astral megafauna stalk and prediction fails to work precisely. The dimension can be used by [[Omega]] to travel or materialize, and the bridge of [[The Last Horizon]] is located within it. Although mundane materials can prevent a ship from sinking into this space, the crew of [[The Last Horizon]] has utilized it to emerge and dive back into the dimension. Ultimately, Subspace acts as a place where creatures can flee and even serves as the destination for half of the [[Grand Hive]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Subspace is a multicolored river of chaos that serves as a dimension for fleet travel and a medium through which the [[Lichborn heavy shuttle]] once moved. This realm can distort sound, cause madness in organic life, and warp or twist mortals into strange dimensions. While it is a method used to store objects like [[Omega]]'s gun, the dimension makes calling [[Divine Titans]] difficult and presents a danger that [[Starhammer]] must avoid when transporting unprotected civilians. During various conflicts, the [[Shadow Ark]] imploded into this space and [[Starhammer]] was forced to exit the realm prematurely. Additionally, interference from Subspace resulted in inconclusive footage regarding [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Subspace serves as a dimension and travel route that can be accessed through ruptures or blooming warps in outer space. While it functions as a storage location for [[Omega]]'s weaponry and entire fleets, the realm is also a dangerous place where entities can be attacked or sent off-course. During travel, the dimension can be blocked, though it has been utilized by the [[D’Niss]] for movement and was once the suspected location of [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. The realm's unpredictable nature is evidenced by the emergence of shimmering-winged soldier ants and the falling of the [[Green Knight]]'s [[Divine Titan]]. Additionally, individuals like [[Javik Leed|Javik]] can reach into this space to summon equipment, such as a two-handed cannon.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Subspace is an inherently unstable dimension or state of reality characterized by a surface of pure darkness that hides rainbow colors and yellow light patterns beneath its shadows. This dark pocket can be accessed by individuals like [[Aila Escalon|Aila]] to retrieve items, used by [[Omega]] to evade telekinesis, or utilized as a refuge for clones and ships waiting for their drives to stabilize. While the [[Aether Core]] allows magic to function within this realm, the dimension contains sanity-shattering depths inhabited by nameless abominations and creatures that certain enemies can pass through. Though it serves as a unique fold of reality for isolation, the area suffers from poor reception and can be manipulated by the Captain to lock individuals inside. Ultimately, Subspace remains a volatile destination that can be viewed through helmet feeds but may become unreachable if its entry points are warped.}}
